decision: No server-side processing: decoding and transcription happen in the visitor browser.
rationale: The product promise is that files never leave the device; a server would contradict it and add cost.
alternatives: Server transcription queue; hybrid with opt-in upload.

decision: Ship as a static bundle in nginx behind the shared Caddy proxy.
rationale: Nothing to compute server-side; the smallest reliable surface.
alternatives: Object storage + CDN; serverless function host.

decision: Publish the image to GHCR and deploy as a Portainer stack per PRIN-3.
rationale: Matches the owner standard for every service.
alternatives: Build on the host (the current state, non-compliant).

decision: The app stores nothing except the browser model cache.
rationale: No accounts, no uploads, nothing to retain or protect.

decision: Interface is English-only at MVP; strings inline.
rationale: Utility audience; translation would double the surface for no current demand.

decision: Vanilla DOM with module state instead of a component framework; deviation from PRAC-2 recorded rather than hidden.
rationale: One screen and a linear flow; a framework adds build weight and state machinery without benefit.
alternatives: React or Svelte with a single store.

decision: Progress is chunk-based with elapsed/remaining and streaming partial text.
rationale: Owner delegated the choice; the blank-screen failure came from an invisible phase.
alternatives: Spinner only; per-chunk bar without text.

decision: No hard file-size limit; preflight device memory and fail honestly on OOM.
rationale: Owner decision: processing is client-side, so the server is not at risk.

decision: WebGPU acceleration deferred; CPU WASM is the MVP path.
rationale: Owner deferred; needs a second weight set and a device picker.
Reproducible builds; the wasm core is a security-relevant binary.
